__NOTOC__

Nintendo provides downloads of manuals for Virtual Console games as standard PDF files. These are hosted at <code>http://m1.nintendo.net/docvc/<console>/<region>/<gameid>/<gameid>_<language>.pdf</code>.

For example, https://m1.nintendo.net/docvc/RVL/EUR/RMGP/RMGP_E.pdf is the English manual for the European release of Super Mario Galaxy.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Section !! Description
|-
| <code>console</code> || The consoles code name
|-
| <code>region</code> || The games region
|-
| <code>gameid</code> || The games internal product ID
|-
| <code>language</code> || Translation language
|}

== Consoles ==

Only the following <code>console</code> values exist on the server:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Code Name !! Console
|-
| <code>NTR</code> || Nintendo DS
|-
| <code>NUS</code> || Nintendo 64
|-
| <code>RVL</code> || Nintendo Wii
|}

== Regions ==

Only the following <code>region</code> values exist on the server:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Value !! Region
|-
| <code>JPN</code> || Japan
|-
| <code>USA</code> || United States
|-
| <code>EUR</code> || Europe
|-
| <code>CHN</code> || China
|-
| <code>KOR</code> || Korea
|-
| <code>TWN</code> || Taiwan
|}

== Game IDs ==

<code>gameid</code> is the games internal product ID.

For example, <code>RMGP</code> refers to [https://www.gametdb.com/Wii/RMGP01 Super Mario Galaxy].

== Languages ==

<code>language</code> is a 1 character language identifier for the manuals translation. If an invalid language is specified, the server returns the English manual.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Identifier !! Language
|-
| J || Japanese
|-
| E || English
|-
| F || French
|-
| G || German
|-
| I || Italian
|-

|-
